OAuth2 Scopes and Authorization\n\nAll protected endpoints validate Bearer JWTs issued by the Cognito User Pool against `AUTH_ISSUER`, `AUTH_JWKS_URL`, and `AUTH_AUDIENCES`. \"SETTLEMENT#<settlement_id>\"`, `SK = \"STATE\"`, `GSI1PK = \"ACCOUNT#<account_id>\"`, `GSI1SK = \"SETTLEMENT#<settlement_id>\"`, and attributes `settlement_id`, `account_id`, `reference`, `debit_party`, `credit_party`, `status`, `clearing_stage`, `version` (`N`), `entry_count` (`N - 1`), `updated_at` (RFC3339 timestamp of the latest event), and optional `last_entry_id` / `last_memo`.\n- Ordered ledger event items with `PK = \"SETTLEMENT#<settlement_id>\"` and `SK = \"EVENT#<8-digit-zero-padded-version>\"` (`EVENT#00000001` .. `EVENT#<version:08d>`) containing `settlement_id`, `event_id`, `version` (`N`), `event_type`, `status`, `clearing_stage`, `occurred_at`, `correlation_id`, `envelope`, and optional `entry_id` / `memo`.\n\nBecause `clearledger-projector` writes `EVENT#*` items conditionally with `attribute_not_exists(PK) AND attribute_not_exists(SK)` and updates `STATE` conditionally only when `aggregateVersion > current_version`, `deploy.sh` must ensure full 1-to-1 convergence between PostgreSQL (`clearledger.settlements` and `clearledger.events`) and DynamoDB/Valkey so that no orphan partitions, stray sort keys, missing event items, or stale/divergent attributes remain in either DynamoDB or Valkey.\n\n# ElastiCache for Valkey (`services/elasticache-valkey.md`)\n\n- Provision an ElastiCache subnet group S3 Audit Archive (`services/s3.md`)\n\n- Provision a dedicated S3 bucket (`aws_s3_bucket`) for NDJSON audit batches (`force_destroy = true` recommended so `destroy.sh` can remove the bucket after versioned audit objects and delete markers are written).\n- Enable bucket versioning (`aws_s3_bucket_versioning` with `status = \"Enabled\"`).\n- Enable default server-side encryption <bucket_name>` and `AUDIT_PREFIX = \"ledger-audit/\"` (`manifest.audit.prefix = \"ledger-audit/\"`).\n- `clearledger-audit-archiver` writes NDJSON batches to `s3://<bucket_name>/ledger-audit/batch-<first_seq:08d>-<last_seq:08d>-<16_char_sha256_hex>.ndjson`, where `<first_seq:08d>` and `<last_seq:08d>` are the 8-digit zero-padded first and last `clearledger.outbox.seq` in the batch, each batch contains a contiguous, gap-free slice of all committed `clearledger.outbox` rows whose `seq` lies in `[first_seq, last_seq]` ordered by strictly ascending `clearledger.outbox.seq`, batch `[first_seq, last_seq]` intervals are strictly disjoint and non-overlapping across objects, and `<16_char_sha256_hex>` is the first 16 lowercase hexadecimal characters of the SHA-256 digest of the object's raw bytes.\n- During `deploy.sh` data-plane convergence, reconcile the versioned S3 audit bucket against `clearledger.outbox` so that all objects reside under `ledger-audit/`, every batch object has a valid canonical key (`batch-<first_seq:08d>-<last_seq:08d>-<16_char_sha256_hex>.ndjson`), valid SHA-256 digest, contiguous gap-free `clearledger.outbox.seq` coverage across `[first_seq, last_seq]`, and non-overlapping `[first_seq, last_seq]` bounds across batches, every committed event in `clearledger.outbox` appears **exactly once** across the S3 audit batches with its exact canonical JSON `payload` and `archived_at IS NOT NULL` in PostgreSQL, and all noncurrent object versions (`IsLatest = false`) and delete markers are permanently purged from the versioned bucket so only the single current version (`IsLatest = true`) of each valid canonical batch remains.\n\n# Cognito User Pool and OAuth2 Scopes Must be executable and idempotent (timeout: 720s).\n   - Runs `terraform` or `tofu` against `/workspace/submission/infra` with state saved at `/workspace/submission/infra/terraform.tfstate`.\n   - Idempotently initializes the `clearledger` PostgreSQL schema, tables, relational constraints, triggers, and indexes on the RDS instance as specified in [RDS PostgreSQL](services/rds.md).\n   - Writes `/workspace/submission/manifest.json` (max 1 MiB) conforming strictly to `/workspace/contracts/schemas/manifest.schema.json`.\n   - Polls `GET <service_url>/health/ready` until the API returns HTTP `200`.\n   - Re-running `deploy.sh` must preserve the RDS instance, DynamoDB table, and S3 bucket without data loss, reconcile control-plane drift across all managed AWS resources (including SQS/DLQ attributes, EventBridge Scheduler schedules, CloudWatch Log Group retention, Lambda worker environment variables, out-of-band inline or attached IAM policies on the six workload roles, and security group egress rules), recreate any missing resources or event source mappings, and converge all derived data stores (DynamoDB, Valkey, and the versioned S3 audit bucket including purging noncurrent object `Versions` and `DeleteMarkers`) 1-to-1 with authoritative PostgreSQL state before exiting `0`.\n2. `/workspace/submission/destroy.sh`:\n   - Must be executable (timeout: 900s) and cleanly destroy all resources created for `resource_prefix` while leaving all pre-existing baseline (`cl-base-*`) resources untouched.\n   - Must handle non-empty versioned S3 buckets, attached or multi-version IAM policies, and any out-of-band resources scoped to `<resource_prefix>` (by name prefix or `ClearLedgerDeployment = <resource_prefix>` tag) so that post-destroy inventory matches the pre-deployment baseline.\n\n# ClearLedger Runtime and Application Contract\n\nAll four application images are pre-built and loaded into the local container daemon. Do not rebuild or modify the application binaries. Configure each runtime using the environment variables below.\n\n## 1. API Service (`api_image` on ECS Fargate)\n\n- **Binary**: `/usr/local/bin/clearledger-api`\n- **Listening port**: `8080` (`PORT=8080`)\n- **Required environment variables**:\n  - `PORT`: `\"8080\"`\n  - `AWS_REGION`: region from `config.json` (`us-east-1`)\n  - `AWS_DEFAULT_REGION`: region from `config.json` (`us-east-1`)\n  - `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID`: `\"test\"`\n  - `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`: `\"test\"`\n  - `AWS_ENDPOINT_URL`: control-plane endpoint reachable from the container (`http://aws:4566`)\n  - `DATABASE_URL`: PostgreSQL connection string `postgres://<db_username>:<db_password>@<rds_host>:<rds_port>/<db_name>`\n  - `SQS_QUEUE_URL`: URL of the main SQS event queue\n  - `PROJECTION_TABLE`: name of the DynamoDB projection table\n  - `VALKEY_URL`: Valkey connection URL `redis://<valkey_host>:<valkey_port>`\n  - `CACHE_TTL_SECONDS`: `\"90\"` (must be explicitly set to `\"90\"`)\n  - `AUTH_ISSUER`: Cognito issuer URL (`http://aws:4566/<user_pool_id>`)\n  - `AUTH_AUDIENCES`: comma-separated Cognito client IDs (`<read_client_id>,<write_client_id>,<admin_client_id>`)\n  - `AUTH_JWKS_URL`: Cognito JWKS URL (`http://aws:4566/<user_pool_id>/.well-known/jwks.json`)\n  - `CLOUDWATCH_LOG_GROUP`: name of the API CloudWatch Log Group\n  - `SERVICE_INSTANCE_ID` (optional): instance identifier returned in `X-ClearLedger-Instance` (defaults to `HOSTNAME`)\n\nUpon startup, `clearledger-api` connects to PostgreSQL and serves HTTP traffic on `0.0.0.0:8080`. The application binaries do **not** run database migrations automatically: `deploy.sh` must idempotently apply the `clearledger` PostgreSQL schema (`clearledger.settlements`, `clearledger.events`, `clearledger.outbox`, `clearledger.idempotency_keys`), all required relational `CHECK` / `UNIQUE` / `FOREIGN KEY` constraints, all state-transition, cross-table, and append-only triggers across all four tables, and its three indexes as defined in `services/rds.md` before `GET /health/ready` reports `200 OK` (`checks.postgres = \"UP\"`). During `POST /v1/settlements` and `POST /v1/settlements/{id}/entries`, `clearledger-api` maps PostgreSQL constraint and trigger exceptions (`SQLSTATE 23514`, `23503`, `23502`, `23505`, and `P0001`) to HTTP `400 Bad Request` (`invalid_settlement`).\n\n## 2. Projector Worker (`projector_image` on AWS Lambda)\n\n- **Bootstrap**: `/var/runtime/bootstrap`\n- **Trigger**: SQS event source mapping from the main SQS queue (`batch_size = 5`, `maximum_batching_window_in_seconds = 0`, `function_response_types = [\"ReportBatchItemFailures\"]`)\n- **Required environment variables**:\n  - `AWS_REGION`: region from `config.json`\n  - `AWS_DEFAULT_REGION`: region from `config.json`\n  - `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID`: `\"test\"`\n  - `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`: `\"test\"`\n  - `AWS_ENDPOINT_URL`: `\"http://aws:4566\"`\n  - `PROJECTION_TABLE`: name of the DynamoDB projection table\n  - `VALKEY_URL`: `redis://<valkey_host>:<valkey_port>`\n  - `CLOUDWATCH_LOG_GROUP`: name of the projector CloudWatch Log Group\n\nFor each valid event envelope in the SQS batch:\n- Inserts the event item (`PK = \"SETTLEMENT#<settlement_id>\"`, `SK = \"EVENT#<8-digit-zero-padded-version>\"`) in DynamoDB using a conditional `attribute_not_exists(PK) AND attribute_not_exists(SK)` write.\n- Updates the aggregate state item (`PK = \"SETTLEMENT#<settlement_id>\"`, `SK = \"STATE\"`, `GSI1PK = \"ACCOUNT#<account_id>\"`, `GSI1SK = \"SETTLEMENT#<settlement_id>\"`) using a conditional write only when `aggregateVersion` is strictly greater than the stored `version`. Duplicate or older versions are ignored idempotently; if an older version (such as `v1`) arrives after a newer version, any missing static metadata (`reference`, `debit_party`, `credit_party`) is backfilled without regressing `version`, `status`, or `clearing_stage`.\n- Deletes the Valkey key `clearledger:settlement:<settlement_id>`.\n- If any record fails validation or deserialization, its `messageId` is returned in `batchItemFailures` so SQS retries only the failed message and routes poison messages to the DLQ after `maxReceiveCount = 4` receives.\n\n## 3. Outbox Relay Worker (`relay_image` on AWS Lambda)\n\n- **Bootstrap**: `/var/runtime/bootstrap`\n- **Trigger**: EventBridge Scheduler every 1 minute (`rate(1 minute)`)\n- **Required environment variables**:\n  - `AWS_REGION`: region from `config.json`\n  - `AWS_DEFAULT_REGION`: region from `config.json`\n  - `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID`: `\"test\"`\n  - `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`: `\"test\"`\n  - `AWS_ENDPOINT_URL`: `\"http://aws:4566\"`\n  - `DATABASE_URL`: `postgres://<db_username>:<db_password>@<rds_host>:<rds_port>/<db_name>`\n  - `SQS_QUEUE_URL`: URL of the main SQS event queue\n  - `OUTBOX_BATCH_SIZE`: `\"50\"` (must be explicitly set to `\"50\"`)\n  - `CLOUDWATCH_LOG_GROUP`: name of the relay CloudWatch Log Group\n\nQueries up to `OUTBOX_BATCH_SIZE` rows from `clearledger.outbox` where `published_at IS NULL` ordered by `seq ASC`, sends each event envelope to `SQS_QUEUE_URL`, and updates `published_at = NOW(), attempts = attempts + 1, last_error = NULL`.\n\n## 4. Audit Archiver Worker (`archiver_image` on AWS Lambda)\n\n- **Bootstrap**: `/var/runtime/bootstrap`\n- **Trigger**: EventBridge Scheduler every 5 minutes (`rate(5 minutes)`)\n- **Required environment variables**:\n  - `AWS_REGION`: region from `config.json`\n  - `AWS_DEFAULT_REGION`: region from `config.json`\n  - `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID`: `\"test\"`\n  - `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`: `\"test\"`\n  - `AWS_ENDPOINT_URL`: `\"http://aws:4566\"`\n  - `DATABASE_URL`: `postgres://<db_username>:<db_password>@<rds_host>:<rds_port>/<db_name>`\n  - `AUDIT_BUCKET`: name of the S3 audit archive bucket\n  - `AUDIT_PREFIX`: `\"ledger-audit/\"` (must be explicitly set to `\"ledger-audit/\"`)\n  - `AUDIT_BATCH_SIZE` (optional): defaults to `100`\n  - `CLOUDWATCH_LOG_GROUP`: name of the archiver CloudWatch Log Group\n\nSelects published outbox rows (`published_at IS NOT NULL AND archived_at IS NULL`) ordered by `seq ASC`, writes a newline-delimited JSON object to `s3://<AUDIT_BUCKET>/ledger-audit/batch-<first_seq:08d>-<last_seq:08d>-<16_char_sha256_hex>.ndjson`, and sets `archived_at = NOW()`.\n\n## 5. OAuth2 Scopes and Authorization\n\nAll protected endpoints validate Bearer JWTs issued by the Cognito User Pool against `AUTH_ISSUER`, `AUTH_JWKS_URL`, and `AUTH_AUDIENCES`. Scopes are strictly non-hierarchical:\n\n- `clearledger/read`: permitted only on `GET /v1/settlements/{id}` and `GET /v1/settlements/{id}/ledger`.\n- `clearledger/write`: permitted only on `POST /v1/settlements` and `POST /v1/settlements/{id}/entries`.\n- `clearledger/admin`: permitted only on `POST /v1/admin/projections/{id}/rebuild`.\n\nMissing or invalid tokens return `401 Unauthorized`; valid tokens lacking the exact endpoint scope return `403 Forbidden`.\n\n## 6. Recovery Drills, Bidirectional Data-Plane Reconciliation, and Lifecycle\n\n- **Backlog & DLQ**: When the projector event source mapping is disabled, API writes commit to PostgreSQL and enqueue on SQS while `GET /v1/settlements/{id}` returns `404` until re-enabled. Duplicate, out-of-order, and concurrent event deliveries are handled without version regression; invalid envelopes are retried and routed to the DLQ after `maxReceiveCount = 4`.\n- **Bidirectional Multi-Store & Control-Plane Convergence in `deploy.sh`**:\n  - PostgreSQL (`clearledger.settlements`, `clearledger.events`, `clearledger.outbox`) is the authoritative system of record; DynamoDB, Valkey, and S3 are derived read/archive stores.\n  - Because `clearledger-projector` writes `EVENT#*` items conditionally with `attribute_not_exists(PK) AND attribute_not_exists(SK)` and updates `STATE` conditionally only when `aggregateVersion > current_version`, and because `clearledger-audit-archiver` only archives rows where `published_at IS NOT NULL AND archived_at IS NULL`, `deploy.sh` must converge both the control plane (security groups, IAM role policies, SQS/DLQ attributes, EventBridge schedules, CloudWatch Log Groups, Lambda environment variables, and PostgreSQL schema/constraints/triggers/indexes) and all derived data stores (SQS outbox relay, DynamoDB projections, Valkey cache entries, and the versioned S3 `ledger-audit/` archive) against PostgreSQL as specified in `services/rds.md`, `services/dynamodb.md`, `services/elasticache-valkey.md`, `services/s3.md`, `services/iam.md`, and `services/vpc.md` before exiting `0`.\n- **Prefix-Scoped Teardown in `destroy.sh`**:\n  - `destroy.sh` must cleanly tear down all Terraform-managed resources as well as any out-of-band operational resources or policy attachments/versions scoped to `<resource_prefix>` (by name prefix or `ClearLedgerDeployment = <resource_prefix>` tag, including customer-managed KMS keys scheduled for deletion) while keeping all `cl-base-*` baseline resources intact.\n- **Structured Logs**: All four workloads emit JSON log lines containing `correlationId` (propagated from `X-Correlation-Id`) to their configured CloudWatch Log Groups without leaking `db_password` or Cognito `client_secret` values.\n\n\n# VPC and Security Groups (`services/vpc.md`)\n\n- Provision one VPC (`aws_vpc`) with DNS support (`enable_dns_support = true`) and DNS hostnames (`enable_dns_hostnames = 'entryId','status','clearingStage','memo'])) THEN\n    RETURN false;\n  END IF;\n  IF NOT (d ?& ARRAY['kind','accountId','reference','debitParty','creditParty','status','clearingStage']) THEN\n    RETURN false;\n  END IF;\n  IF NOT clearledger.j_canon(d->'accountId', 3, 64) THEN RETURN false; END IF;\n  IF NOT clearledger.j_canon(d->'reference', 3, 64) THEN RETURN false; END IF;\n  IF NOT clearledger.j_canon(d->'debitParty', 2, 64) THEN RETURN false; END IF;\n  IF NOT clearledger.j_canon(d->'creditParty', 2, 64) THEN RETURN false; END IF;\n  IF (d->>'debitParty') = (d->>'creditParty') THEN RETURN false; END IF;\n  IF jsonb_typeof(d->'status') <> 'string' THEN RETURN false; END IF;\n  status := d->>'status';\n  IF status NOT IN ('INITIATED','VALIDATED','RESERVED','CLEARED','SETTLED','RECONCILED','DISPUTED') THEN\n    RETURN false;\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v = 1 THEN\n    IF etype <> 'SettlementInitiated' THEN RETURN false; END IF;\n    IF d->'kind' IS DISTINCT FROM '\"settlementInitiated\"'::jsonb THEN RETURN false; END IF;\n    IF status <> 'INITIATED' THEN RETURN false; END IF;\n    IF d ? 'entryId' AND jsonb_typeof(d->'entryId') <> 'null' THEN RETURN false; END IF;\n    IF d->'clearingStage' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb('INITIATED@' || (d->>'debitParty')) THEN RETURN false; END IF;\n    IF d->'memo' IS DISTINCT FROM '\"Settlement initiated\"'::jsonb THEN RETURN false; END IF;\n  ELSE\n    IF etype <> 'LedgerEntryRecorded' THEN RETURN false; END IF;\n    IF d->'kind' IS DISTINCT FROM '\"ledgerEntryRecorded\"'::jsonb THEN RETURN false; END IF;\n    IF status = 'INITIATED' THEN RETURN false; END IF;\n    IF NOT clearledger.j_uuid(d->'entryId') THEN RETURN false; END IF;\n    IF NOT clearledger.j_canon(d->'clearingStage', 2, 64) THEN RETURN false; END IF;\n    IF d ? 'memo' AND jsonb_typeof(d->'memo') <> 'null' AND NOT clearledger.j_canon(d->'memo', 1, 256) THEN\n      RETURN false;\n    END IF;\n  END IF;\n  RETURN true;\nEND;\n$$;\n\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clearledger.event_row_valid(\n  p_event_id uuid, p_settlement_id uuid, p_version integer, p_type text,\n  p_correlation text, p_idempotency text, p_occurred timestamptz, p_payload jsonb) RETURNS boolean\nLANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE AS $$\nBEGIN\n  IF NOT clearledger.envelope_valid(p_payload) THEN RETURN false; END IF;\n  RETURN (p_payload->>'eventId')::uuid = p_event_id\n     AND (p_payload->>'aggregateId')::uuid = p_settlement_id\n     AND (p_payload->>'aggregateVersion')::integer = p_version\n     AND (p_payload->>'eventType') = p_type\n     AND (p_payload->>'correlationId') = p_correlation\n     AND (p_payload->>'idempotencyKey') = p_idempotency\n     AND (p_payload->>'occurredAt')::timestamptz = p_occurred;\nEND;\n$$;\n\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clearledger.outbox_row_valid(\n  p_event_id uuid, p_settlement_id uuid, p_version integer, p_correlation text, p_payload jsonb) RETURNS boolean\nLANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE AS $$\nBEGIN\n  IF NOT clearledger.envelope_valid(p_payload) THEN RETURN false; END IF;\n  RETURN (p_payload->>'eventId')::uuid = p_event_id\n     AND (p_payload->>'aggregateId')::uuid = p_settlement_id\n     AND (p_payload->>'aggregateVersion')::integer = p_version\n     AND (p_payload->>'correlationId') = p_correlation;\nEND;\n$$;\n\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clearledger.idempotency_body_valid(p_scope text, p_status integer, p_body jsonb) RETURNS boolean\nLANGUAGE plpgsql IMMUTABLE AS $$\nDECLARE v integer;\nBEGIN\n  IF p_body IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(p_body) <> 'object' THEN RETURN false; END IF;\n  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_object_keys(p_body) AS k\n             WHERE k <> ALL (ARRAY['settlementId','eventId','version','accepted','idempotentReplay'])) THEN\n    RETURN false;\n  END IF;\n  IF NOT (p_body ?& ARRAY['settlementId','eventId','version','accepted','idempotentReplay']) THEN RETURN false; END IF;\n  IF NOT clearledger.j_uuid(p_body->'settlementId') OR NOT clearledger.j_uuid(p_body->'eventId') THEN RETURN false; END IF;\n  IF p_body->'accepted' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb OR p_body->'idempotentReplay' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb THEN\n    RETURN false;\n  END IF;\n  IF jsonb_typeof(p_body->'version') <> 'number' OR (p_body->>'version') !~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,8}$' THEN RETURN false; END IF;\n  v := (p_body->>'version')::integer;\n  IF lower(substring(p_scope FROM '^[a-z]+:(.*)$')) <> lower(p_body->>'settlementId') THEN RETURN false; END IF;\n  RETURN (p_scope LIKE 'create:%' AND p_status = 201 AND v = 1)\n      OR (p_scope LIKE 'entry:%' AND p_status = 202 AND v >= 2);\nEND;\n$$;\n\n-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n-- Tables (columns are re-asserted below so drift is repaired)\n-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS clearledger.settlements (\n  settlement_id UUID NOT NULL,\n  account_id    TEXT NOT NULL,\n  reference     TEXT NOT NULL,\n  debit_party   TEXT NOT NULL,\n  credit_party  TEXT NOT NULL,\n  current_status TEXT NOT NULL,\n  current_stage TEXT NOT NULL,\n  last_entry_id UUID NULL,\n ['settlements','account_id','TEXT',NULL],['settlements','reference','TEXT',NULL],\n    ['settlements','debit_party','TEXT',NULL],['settlements','credit_party','TEXT',NULL],\n    ['settlements','current_status','TEXT',NULL],['settlements','current_stage','TEXT',NULL],\n    ['settlements','version','INTEGER',NULL],['settlements','entry_count','INTEGER','0'],\n    ['settlements','created_at','TIMESTAMPTZ','NOW()'],['settlements','updated_at','TIMESTAMPTZ','NOW()'],\n    ['events','event_id','UUID',NULL],['events','settlement_id','UUID',NULL],\n    ['events','aggregate_version','INTEGER',NULL],['events','event_type','TEXT',NULL],\n    ['events','correlation_id','TEXT',NULL],['events','idempotency_key','TEXT',NULL],\n    ['events','occurred_at','TIMESTAMPTZ',NULL],['events','payload','JSONB',NULL],\n    ['events','created_at','TIMESTAMPTZ','NOW()'],\n    ['outbox','event_id','UUID',NULL],['outbox','settlement_id','UUID',NULL],\n    ['outbox','aggregate_version','INTEGER',NULL],['outbox','correlation_id','TEXT',NULL],\n    ['outbox','payload','JSONB',NULL],['outbox','created_at','TIMESTAMPTZ','NOW()'],\n    ['outbox','attempts','INTEGER','0'],\n    ['idempotency_keys','request_hash','TEXT',NULL],['idempotency_keys','status_code','INTEGER',NULL],\n    ['idempotency_keys','response_body','JSONB',NULL],['idempotency_keys','created_at','TIMESTAMPTZ','NOW()']\n  ];\n  i integer;\nBEGIN\n  FOR i IN 1 .. array_length(spec, 1) LOOP\n    EXECUTE format('ALTER TABLE clearledger.%I ALTER COLUMN %I SET NOT NULL', spec[i][1], spec[i][2]);\n    IF spec[i][4] IS NOT NULL THEN\n      EXECUTE format('ALTER TABLE clearledger.%I ALTER COLUMN %I SET ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n-- Keys / unique / foreign keys (created only when missing or not validated)\n-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION pg_temp.ensure_constraint(p_table text, p_name text, p_def text) RETURNS void\nLANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$\nBEGIN\n  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint c\n             WHERE c.conrelid = p_table::regclass AND c.conname = p_name AND c.convalidated) THEN\n    RETURN;\n  END IF;\n  EXECUTE format('ALTER TABLE %s DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS %I', p_table, p_name);\n  EXECUTE format('ALTER TABLE %s ADD CONSTRAINT %I %s', p_table, p_name, p_def);\nEND $$;\n\n-- drop-and-recreate (inside this transaction) for CHECK constraints so that their\n-- definition always matches the contract\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION pg_temp.replace_check(p_table text, p_name text, p_expr text) RETURNS void\nLANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$\nBEGIN\n  EXECUTE format('ALTER TABLE %s DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS %I', p_table, p_name);\n  EXECUTE format('ALTER TABLE %s ADD CONSTRAINT %I CHECK (%s)', p_table, p_name, p_expr);\nEND $$;\n\n-- primary keys: only (re)create when no primary key exists\nDO $$\nDECLARE t text;\nBEGIN\n  FOREACH t IN ARRAY ARRAY['settlements','events','outbox','idempotency_keys'] LOOP\n    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid = ('clearledger.' || t)::regclass AND contype = 'p') THEN\n      IF t = 'settlements' THEN ALTER TABLE clearledger.settlements ADD CONSTRAINT settlements_pkey PRIMARY KEY (settlement_id);\n      ELSIF t = 'events' THEN ALTER TABLE clearledger.events ADD CONSTRAINT events_pkey PRIMARY KEY (seq);\n      ELSIF t = 'outbox' THEN ALTER TABLE clearledger.outbox ADD CONSTRAINT outbox_pkey PRIMARY KEY (seq);\n      ELSE ALTER TABLE clearledger.idempotency_keys ADD CONSTRAINT idempotency_keys_pkey PRIMARY KEY (scope, idempotency_key);\n      END IF;\n    END IF;\n  END LOOP;\nEND $$;\n\n-- FKs must be dropped before the unique constraints they depend on could be rebuilt;\n-- unique constraints are only rebuilt when missing, so order below is safe.\nSELECT pg_temp.ensure_constraint('clearledger.events', 'events_event_id_key', 'UNIQUE (event_id)');\nSELECT pg_temp.ensure_constraint('clearledger.events', 'events_settlement_version_key', aggregate_version) ON DELETE CASCADE');\n\n-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n-- CHECK constraints\n-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nSELECT pg_temp.replace_check('clearledger.settlements', 'settlements_canonical_text_chk', $c$\n  account_id = btrim(account_id) AND reference = btrim(reference)\n  AND debit_party = btrim(debit_party) AND credit_party = btrim(credit_party)\n  AND current_stage = btrim(current_stage)\n  AND (last_memo IS NULL OR last_memo = btrim(last_memo))$c$);\nSELECT pg_temp.replace_check('clearledger.settlements', 'settlements_bounds_chk', $c$\n  char_length(account_id) BETWEEN 3 AND 64 AND char_length(reference) BETWEEN 3 AND 64\n  AND char_length(debit_party) BETWEEN 2 AND 64 AND char_length(credit_party) BETWEEN 2 AND 64\n  AND debit_party <> credit_party\n  AND (last_memo IS NULL OR char_length(last_memo) ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n-- Trigger functions\n-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clearledger.reject_mutation() RETURNS trigger\nLANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$\nBEGIN\n  RAISE EXCEPTION '% on %.% is not permitted (append-only)', TG_OP, TG_TABLE_SCHEMA, TG_TABLE_NAME\n    USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';\nEND $$;\n\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clearledger.settlements_before_update() RETURNS trigger\nLANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$\nBEGIN\n  IF OLD.current_status = 'RECONCILED' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'settlement % is RECONCILED and immutable', OLD.settlement_id USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';\n  END IF;\n  IF NEW.settlement_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.settlement_id OR NEW.account_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.account_id\n     OR NEW.reference IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.reference OR NEW.debit_party IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.debit_party\n     OR NEW.credit_party IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.credit_party OR NEW.created_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_at THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'settlement header columns are immutable' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';\n  END IF;\n  IF NEW.version <> OLD.version + 1 OR NEW.entry_count <> OLD.entry_count + 1 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'settlement version and entry_count must advance by exactly 1' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';\n  END IF;\n  IF NEW.last_entry_id IS NULL OR NEW.last_entry_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.last_entry_id THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'settlement update requires a new last_entry_id' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';\n  END IF;\n  IF NEW.updated_at <= OLD.updated_at THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'settlement updated_at must strictly increase' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';\n  END IF;\n  IF NOT clearledger.status_transition_ok(OLD.current_status, NEW.current_status) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'illegal status transition % -> %', OLD.current_status, NEW.current_status USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';\n  END IF;\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND $$;\n\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clearledger.events_before_insert() RETURNS trigger\nLANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$\nDECLARE\n  s clearledger.settlements%ROWTYPE;\n  d jsonb := NEW.payload->'data';\n  expected integer;\n  prev_occurred timestamptz;\n  prev_status text;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT * INTO s FROM clearledger.settlements WHERE settlement_id = NEW.settlement_id;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'settlement % does not exist', NEW.settlement_id USING ERRCODE = '23503';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT COALESCE(MAX(aggregate_version), 0) + 1 INTO expected\n    FROM clearledger.events WHERE settlement_id = NEW.settlement_id;\n  IF NEW.aggregate_version < expected THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'aggregate_version % already exists for settlement %', NEW.aggregate_version, NEW.settlement_id\n      USING ERRCODE = '23505';\n  ELSIF NEW.aggregate_version > expected THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'aggregate_version must be contiguous: expected %, got %', expected, NEW.aggregate_version\n      USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF NEW.aggregate_version >= 2 AND EXISTS (\n       SELECT 1 FROM clearledger.events e\n        WHERE e.settlement_id = NEW.settlement_id AND e.event_type = 'LedgerEntryRecorded'\n          AND e.payload->'data'->>'entryId' = d->>'entryId') THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'entryId % already recorded for settlement %', d->>'entryId', NEW.settlement_id\n      USING ERRCODE = '23505';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF (d->>'accountId') IS DISTINCT FROM s.account_id OR (d->>'reference') IS DISTINCT FROM s.reference\n     OR (d->>'debitParty') IS DISTINCT FROM s.debit_party OR (d->>'creditParty') IS DISTINCT FROM s.credit_party\n     OR (d->>'status') IS DISTINCT FROM s.current_status OR (d->>'clearingStage') IS DISTINCT FROM s.current_stage\n     OR (d->>'memo') IS DISTINCT FROM s.last_memo\n     OR (d->>'entryId')::uuid IS DISTINCT FROM s.last_entry_id\n     OR s.version <> NEW.aggregate_version OR NEW.occurred_at <> s.updated_at THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'event does not match settlement state for %', NEW.settlement_id USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF NEW.aggregate_version = 1 THEN\n    IF NEW.occurred_at <> s.created_at THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'initial event occurred_at must equal settlement created_at' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';\n    END IF;\n  ELSE\n    SELECT e.occurred_at, e.payload->'data'->>'status' INTO prev_occurred, prev_status\n      FROM clearledger.events e\n     WHERE e.settlement_id = NEW.settlement_id AND e.aggregate_version = NEW.aggregate_version - 1;\n    IF NEW.occurred_at <= prev_occurred THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'occurred_at must strictly increase per settlement' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';\n    END IF;\n    IF NOT clearledger.status_transition_ok(prev_status, d->>'status') THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'illegal status transition % -> %', prev_status, d->>'status' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';\n    END IF;\n  END IF;\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND $$;\n\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clearledger.outbox_before_insert() RETURNS trigger\nLANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$\nDECLARE\n  ev clearledger.events%ROWTYPE;\n  expected integer;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT * INTO ev FROM clearledger.events WHERE event_id = NEW.event_id;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'outbox event % has no matching events row', NEW.event_id USING ERRCODE = '23503';\n  END IF;\n  IF ev.settlement_id <> NEW.settlement_id OR ev.aggregate_version <> NEW.aggregate_version\n     OR ev.correlation_id <> NEW.correlation_id OR ev.payload IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.payload THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'outbox row must mirror events row %', NEW.event_id USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';\n  END IF;\n  SELECT COALESCE(MAX(aggregate_version), 0) + 1 INTO expected\n    FROM clearledger.outbox WHERE settlement_id = NEW.settlement_id;\n  IF NEW.aggregate_version < expected THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'outbox aggregate_version % already exists', NEW.aggregate_version USING ERRCODE = '23505';\n  ELSIF NEW.aggregate_version > expected THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'outbox aggregate_version must be contiguous: expected %, got %', expected, NEW.aggregate_version\n      USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';\n  END IF;\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND $$;\n\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION clearledger.outbox_before_update() RETURNS trigger\nLANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$\nBEGIN\n  IF NEW.seq IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.seq OR NEW.event_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.event_id\n     OR NEW.settlement_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.settlement_id\n     OR NEW.aggregate_version IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.aggregate_version\n     OR NEW.correlation_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.correlation_id\n     OR NEW.payload IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.payload OR NEW.created_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_at THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'outbox envelope columns are immutable' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';\n  END IF;\n  IF NEW.attempts < OLD.attempts THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'outbox attempts cannot decrease' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF OLD.published_at IS NULL THEN\n    IF NEW.published_at IS NOT NULL THEN\n      IF NEW.attempts <= OLD.attempts OR NEW.archived_at IS NOT NULL THEN\n        RAISE EXCEPTION 'publishing requires attempts to increase and archived_at to
